title: Worth it ONLY if you monitor the monthly selection before it's shipped.
text:
So far out of the five months since I've joined, three of my selections was being sold on Amazon for the same price or several dollars cheaper to non-members. It was worth it for the other two records.

I've able to cancel in time, but it still feels like a scam to sell records to members for more than the price of non-members.
label: neutral
